objective: Extend only the opt-in R50 conv-only and delta-only serial diagnostics to the exact two-request pure-spec shape localized by R77, then identify which GDN stage causes the layer-1 divergence.

code_boundary.new_scope: two to 64 pure-spec requests, uniform active width two to nine, only when the corresponding split diagnostic environment flag is true

decision: A stage is implicated only if its arm returns two complete 128-token outputs, both exactly match the R72 oracle, cached_tokens are both zero, its r79 runtime marker is present on both TP ranks, and there is no new GPU/Xe/OOM fault. If both or neither pass, no single-stage causal claim is allowed.
promotion_boundary: Diagnostic only on this boot. Any candidate fix must preserve the current single-user speed floor and pass the complete prose/code/document, deterministic repeat, context-depth, and concurrency identity gates on a clean boot before recipe or site promotion.
